title: Read pinned evidence notes
responsibility: Read commit-keyed notes from an immutable revision and memoize within one authorized context.

inputs.name: hubNotes.base
inputs.description: The caller-owned immutable authorized context passed to pinned-source lookup. Reads are memoized by this object’s identity, so entries are not shared across contexts.

inputs.name: hubNotes.pinned
inputs.description: The source revision whose notes are loaded; null bypasses source lookup and resolves to an empty map. For a string, that revision participates with the context identity in memoization.

outputs.name: hubNotes
outputs.description: A promise for a map from commit IDs to the ReadNote values returned by readNoteLines. An entry is included only when it is a blob whose path becomes a 40-character lowercase hexadecimal ID after slashes are removed and whose mode is 100644 or 100755; null returns a fresh empty map, while non-null reads share a promise per context identity and pin.

errors.name: invalid-notes
errors.description: The loader calls hubFail('invalid-notes') when a candidate note blob has a mode other than 100644 or 100755, or its path-derived commit key duplicates one already loaded.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Fatal UTF-8 decoding rejects with TypeError when a candidate note blob contains invalid UTF-8.

errors.name: Hub note or pinned source read failure
errors.description: Errors thrown by readNoteLines or rejected by hubPinnedSource or hubRaw propagate through the returned promise because this function does not catch them.
